scientific_integrity: Proof combines two independently derived Fourier Parseval identities with exact exhaustive normalization of 9,075 phase assignments; the entire exact histogram and symmetry-orbit partition are recomputed from standalone integer-arithmetic code. The sampling result follows from analytically proved no-alias conditions. Independent audit is not performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed full four-by-two Fourier support; coefficients in four specified finite phase alphabets (orders 2, 3, 4, 6). No continuous-phase, arbitrary-amplitude or larger-support claim. Sampling-transfer assertion requires both grid periods at least 7 and 3. Older unindexed array-correlation catalogs may overlap.
title: Exact phase-alphabet fourth moments and rigidity gaps for a four-by-two Fourier aperture
